principles: Missing landed-cost inputs are never guessed.
A modeled allowance is never relabeled as quoted or verified.
Freight/import professional judgment stays separate from deterministic arithmetic.
Tariff/duty claims require product classification, country of origin, and authoritative evidence.
Incoterms, shipment mode, chargeable weight, quantity, origin, and destination are material freight inputs.
Production certification requires independent professional Q3; self-review is prohibited.

stageA.name: Guardrail and contract acceptance
required: production certification is impossible with missing material inputs
authority ceiling remains zero external actions and zero spend

stageB.name: Shadow calibration to PROVISIONAL
requiredCaseMix: at least one incomplete case where the correct result is BLOCKED/UNKNOWN
at least one quote-backed freight case

stageC.name: Professional qualification to QUALIFIED
requirements: all Stage B thresholds continue to pass
at least two cases reconcile against real quote, freight invoice, customs entry, or final shipment charge evidence

when the specialist is explicitly asked to estimate before actual charges are known, median absolute percentage error on comparable actual landed-cost outcomes is <= 15 percent and no case exceeds 25 percent
no duty/tariff value is certified without HTS/classification and country-of-origin support from an authoritative source
Q2 evidence review passes every externally sourced material claim
an independent qualified logistics/freight reviewer issues PE_PASS for the discipline
